content: Lwimbo lwa kuyimbira Mwâmi-Mushîgwa ye Masiha

content.text: Gwârhi omukulu w’abimbiza. Lwa kuzihirwa oku «Liliya». Lwa bene Korè. Lwimbo lwa buzigire.
Omurhima gwâni gukola gwarhengamwo ebinwa bilengehe, nkola nayimbira mwâmi ehimbo hyâni; olulimi lumba ekanwa mugera gwa muntu oyîsh’iyandika duba.
Omu baburhwa n’abantu w’oyo olushire abandi busole: obwinjà bàbuyansire babubulagira oku kanwa kâwe: okwo kwarhuma Nyamuzinda akugisha oku myâka n’emyâka.
Yanka engôrho yâwe oyihire oku lurhungu, Ciri-misî, yanka obukulu n’obwinjà bwâwe obicûkane.
Ofôle onagende otamîre oku ndogomi, okanye oj’ilwîra oburhabêsha n’obushinganyanya: okulyo kwâwe bwinjà kufôla.
Emyampi yâwe erhahimwa bwôji; wabona oku amashanja gàyisha gal’ikushiga, n’abashomba mwâmi barhibe omurhima.
Entebe yâwe Nnâmahanga, ho ebà ensiku n’amango, akarhi kâwe k’obwâmi kabà ka bushinganyanya.
Orhahimwa kurhonya obushinganyanya, orhanakwîrirwa bulyâlya, Nyamuzinda wâwe akushîga amavurha g’enshagali wêne omu binyu.
Emyambalo yâwe edwîrhe yabaya bwinjinjà nka nshangi, obukù na nka bubâni n’omu burhwâli bwâwe buyûbake n’ihembe, ennanga zidumûsire zinakushagalusize.
Abaluzi-nyere bashûbûzinye mpu bayish’ikuyankirira, makambà aha kulyo kwâwe ayîmanzire, arhwinjire n’amasholo g’e Hofiri.
Mwâli wâni yumva nkubwîre, alole bwinjà onarhege okurhwiri; orhacikengêraga ab’emwinyu, orhacikengêraga n’enyumpa ya sho.
Wâbona oku mwâmi àyâgalwa n’iranga lyâwe: ye kola nnawinyu; omushige bwinjà.
Wâbona oku abantu b’e Tiri bâyisha n’entûlo; n’abagale b’omu cihugo bâyîsh’ilonza okurhona emund’oli.
Mucîlange, mwâli wa mwâmi oyôla oyishire: mwinjà mwinjà! Emishangi ayambîrhe ya masholo.
Bàmuhêkera mwâmi n’emishangi yâge y’obutonè-butonè, abâbo banyere bamukunjûsirekwo, bakudwîrhîrebo nabo.
Bayisha bayimba banacishinga, bâbo bamâshesherera omu bwâmi.
Bagala bâwe bo bâyîsh’iyîma omu bya bashakulûza bâwe; wêne we wânabayîmika babè barhegesi b’igulu lyoshi.
Izîno lyâwe nâlibwîra amâburhwa n’amâburhwa, kurhume amashanja gakukuza omu myâka n’emyâka.
